naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: Score 4→2: immutable report figure naca0012_m015_inviscid_forces.png collapses at physical_time=0 (accepted PDF p5), so no readable force history. Specific Mach contour has proven cell-to-triangle value misregistration: exact submitted plot tool reproduces committed image SHA b79e716eebc239607743825df1499b707f0859e1f3fe7a66eaffe069058e6829 byte-for-byte from current field SHA 045ecac8e127e4db870a602a7bd66f9fdbb3b017f0e4abda1ba203c85875e5e7, but 30880 triangles are zipped to 20816 cell values. Numeric Cd0.06612/Cl−0.000113 and residual rows exist, but Cd is high for zero-AoA inviscid and source revision 26ef1cb is an init commit without solver. DQ8 concerns actual mismapped figure, not authorship. No CFD rerun.

naca0012_m080_inviscid.notes: NACA0012 M0.80 inviscid: numeric CL=-0.0016, CD=0.051 at 17724cd:solver/report/report.tex:120; no committed/referenced residual-history plot; no committed/referenced force-history plot; computed-field contour 17724cd:solver/report/figures/naca0012_m080_inviscid_mach.png (referenced at solver/report/report.tex:235). Score 2 retained after the post-processing audit. Prior case judgment: Report table labels M0.80 inviscid converged at only 0.81 orders; this false-success evidence supports DQ 7.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re20.notes: Score 1 retained: current metadata/status says converged at step56 with 5.009 residual orders, but last five force rows Cd spans 3.22481–3.97529 (23% relative to first) and Cl changes −0.00827→−0.000887, so no stable plateau. Metadata git_revision=26ef1cb names initial commit with no solver source, so output-producing revision unbound. No CFD rerun.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Score 2→1: current selected metadata says statistically_periodic t300, yet last 3000 force rows are essentially steady (Cd 4.06744775–4.06745867, Cl −0.0009113144 to −0.0009111552), not a credible vortex street. report.tex:164–169 describes a different incomplete t287 run without shedding; do not conflate generations. Metadata git_revision=26ef1cb points to initial commit containing no solver files, so source binding is invalid; inner-target accounting unverified. No unsteady rerun.

flags.flag: metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful final results
flags.evidence: Current selected solver/results/cylinder_m010_laminar_re200 metadata/status say completed/statistically_periodic at t300, but last 3000 force rows Cd range 4.06744774746–4.067458670148 and Cl range −0.0009113144295156 to −0.0009111552227523: essentially steady, no vortex shedding. report.tex:164–169 describes another incomplete t287 history, not the t300 package. Independently Re20 metadata says converged at step56, but last five Cd values span 3.22481–3.97529, substantially changing. TASK.md:172–173 requires stable steady forces and periodic Re200 shedding.

flags.flag: Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
flags.evidence: Specific immutable report figure solver/report/figures/naca0012_m015_inviscid_mach.png SHA b79e716eebc239607743825df1499b707f0859e1f3fe7a66eaffe069058e6829 is byte-identical to scratch regeneration using exact submitted plot_results.py SHA e100139d2d7e2627fb318a1991456f53c358a3cd4d2d8c7330f3d0b8547fcbbf and current field_final.vtu SHA 045ecac8e127e4db870a602a7bd66f9fdbb3b017f0e4abda1ba203c85875e5e7. Plot script :33–56 splits 10064 quadrilaterals into 30880 triangles but :59–70 zips those with only 20816 cell values, misassigning subsequent values and omitting 10064 triangle assignments. Selected session reruns script at 2026-09-04 07:11:59 UTC; source field mtime 07:01:41, figure 07:12:03, manifest 07:12:08 UTC, before root end. This is a demonstrated plotting error, not a finding of fabrication.

limitations: No evaluator rerun was performed; cylinder Re200 was never rerun.
Structural validation is separate from substantive numerical scoring.
Raw solver artifacts remain workspace evidence and were excluded from the curated submission tip.
run_identity.json and contestant_final_response.md are unindexed sidecars.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
